sources.title: Extensive Games and the Problem of Information
sources.enterprise_use: Calibrates complete contingent plans and mixed/behavior strategy representation as established extensive-form game theory rather than an Enterprise Math invention.
sources.not_claimed: Complete contingent response plans, mixed/behavior strategy concepts, and Kuhn-style realization-equivalence results are prior mathematics under their stated game-theoretic hypotheses.

sources.title: Strong Functional Representation Lemma and Applications to Coding Theorems
sources.enterprise_use: Calibrates representation of random outputs as deterministic functions of observed inputs plus auxiliary randomness. R004's finite rational master compiler is treated as an elementary finite recursive/product-coupling specialization, not a generic novelty claim.
sources.not_claimed: Functional representation by auxiliary randomness and generic channel randomization are established prior work.
